newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita Elec to put priority on chip business.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita Elec to put priority on chip business.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd will put a priority on its semiconductor business, the company said in its long-term business plan on Friday.
Under the "Development 2000 plan", Matsushita will focus on optical discs, mobile communications, display devices and semiconductors as its four major strategic business areas.
Emphasis will be made in particular on semiconductors, the company said.
The business plan covers a four-year period starting from April.
It will launch two new divisions within the parent company to develop and market semiconductors in the first year, the company said.
The company as a group aims to shift its emphasis further to parts and components business and away from household electric appliances and industrial machines.
Matsushita expects parts and components to account for 33 percent of the group's total production by March 2001, up from 28 percent in the year ended March 1996.
Overseas sales will make up 50 percent of the group's total sales, against 45 percent in 1995/96.
Matsushita said it expects the ratio of its overseas production to rise to 30 percent by March 2001, up from 25 percent in 1995/96.
